name: Boxguy Adventure 3: Super Boxguy World
storyline: Boxguy the Box returns once again! After the events of Boxguy Adventure and Boxguy Adventure 2… Boxguy is now in dinosaur land somehow! Man… why does Boxguy always gets transported to the wrong world every time he defeats a world’s villain when the hero of that world has to M.I.A for whatever reason.
